liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **The Music Never Stopped** (2 reviews): Reviewer calls it beautiful, with Jerry soaring like a bird above the band's mountain-range backdrop [7][8]
- **New Minglewood Blues** (1 review): Reviewer says this version smokes, especially for an era of easy, loping grooves [15]
- **Bertha** (1 review): Reviewer says the band fully drew them in by Bertha, after sensing something happening at Minglewood [14]
- **Sugaree** (1 review): Reviewer says the ending is unusually strong rather than filler, driven by Billy steering with Phil [17]
- **Drums** (1 review): Jerry can be heard urging Billy and Mickey to keep playing all night [10]
- **The Other One** (1 review): Runs over 13 minutes; Phil drops bombs while Garcia works the wah and keeps pushing the band [9]

## The recordings

- **gd1976-10-15.167995.ecm280.bertrando.flac2496** (recommended): soundboard; 21 songs; 171 min [1]. Said about its sound: Despite minor flaws, uploader says it sounds significantly better than other circulating audience tapes of this show [1]
- **gd76-10-15.bertrando.vernon.11655.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 21 songs; 170 min; rated 4.57/5 by 13 [2]. Said about its sound: Reviewer prefers this audience tape to the soundboard, suggesting a big bass boost below 80 Hz and slight treble lift; Describes the audience recording as clean and nice, with a better mix than the alternative; Reviewer says Rob's audience tape is significantly better than their own [11][14][18]
- **gd1976-10-15.sbd.miller.84260.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 21 songs; 165 min; rated 4.8/5 by 15 [4]
- **gd1976-10-15.sbd.sacks.32060.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 21 songs; 163 min; rated 5/5 by 2 [5]. Said about its sound: Flaws include digi-static at the start, a reel flip in Lazy Lightning, and a splice in Samson [5]

## Around the show

- A friend recalled green lights on Jerry's amp forming a smiling Buddha for about five minutes during the jam after He's Gone [7]
- A friend recalled green lights on Jerry's amp forming a smiling Buddha for about five minutes during the jam after He's Gone [8]
- Reviewer wonders if the Shrine's Moorish-influenced architecture and otherworldly interior explain the band's long, fruitful history there [10]
- Reviewer's first show; they stood about five rows back on the stage-left side, near the front [14]
- The band rises to the occasion in the Shrine's decorous setting, giving every song extra kick [16]
- Reviewer recalls the Shrine as an opulent old theater where gyrating Deadheads seemed out of place [18]
- Blogger says the second set of this show made them a lifelong Deadhead [22]
- Reviewer likens this show to the Orpheum show of 7/17/76, rating both five stars [9]
- Rated alongside 7/17 and 7/16 as the year's best audience recordings; soundboards don't do these shows justice [16]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1976-10-15.167995.ecm280.bertrando.flac2496**: taped by Rob Bertrando; transferred by Rob Bertrando; source: Sony ECM-280 mics on balcony ledge next to SBD > Sony TC-152 (Sony chrome tape) > Sony TC-755 reel @ 3.75 ips [1]
- **gd76-10-15.bertrando.vernon.11655.sbeok.shnf**: taped by Rob Bertrando; source: Audience Recording: Sony ECM-280s>Sony TC-152 [2]. Also: The audience microphones sat at the front of the balcony, right beside the soundboard; Reviewer smuggled in a Sony TC-126 and taped the show, though arriving late after a security check; Recorded by Rob Bertrando with Sony ECM-280 microphones into a Sony TC-152; transfer chain MAC, DAT, CD [2][11][18]
- **gd1976-10-15.sbd.miller.84260.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Master Reel -> Dat -> CD D [4]. Also: Source chain: Sony ECM-280, cassette master, DAT, CD; uploader cleaned flaws and patched tape flips; Patches for Samson and Delilah and the end of Comes A Time come from Rob Bertrando's recording [4]
- **gd1976-10-15.sbd.sacks.32060.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Darrin Sacks; source: MSR>DATs>CDRs>EAC>SHN [5]. Also: EAC extraction and SHN conversion done by darrin; a 2005 note reports sector boundary errors [5]

## Art and photos

- Poster by LiveGRATEFUL.net: [Grateful Dead 1976-10-15 Fri Shrine Auditorium, Los Angeles, CA](https://www.livegrateful.net/post/1416203067338/grateful-dead-1976-10-15-fri-shrine) [24]
- Fan art by johnsdeadart.blogspot.com: [John's Custom Grateful Dead Album Cover Art](https://johnsdeadart.blogspot.com/2017/05/blog-post_21.html) [25]
